governance: Taxonomy scaffold only. Metadata vocabulary for future use. Defines no dose, no progression, no readiness, no RTT/RTS clearance, no plan generation. Not wired into runtime.
description: Taxonomy of assessment purposes. Assessment objects record evidence only; they do not prescribe rehab and do not clear athletes unless future governed readiness rules explicitly authorize it.
